name: Çöl Kervanı
scene: Two laden dromedary camels cross sweeping desert dunes beneath a round moon and distant ridges.
notes: Design sheet only; target 110–160 panes, generation aimed at 125. Warm pair reserved for camels and packs; cool pair for dunes, ridges, sky and moon. Inspected both attempts; one corrective regeneration removed floating mouth strokes and supplied a white exterior. Remaining doubts: subtle fill shading remains, some background meetings may be four-way or narrowly spaced, and adjacent same-colour pieces occur in packs and background. Pane count and junction geometry require downstream tracing and audit; this sheet is not certified production geometry.
